text:
anya: heads-up: propose adding origin tag to saved queries (route/model/pinned) so console can show where queries came from for cost + ownership.

devin: +1. keep it minimal: origin="route:r-77|model:rook-3b|pin:variant-1" — easy to parse short-term.

leo: api: optional origin string field on POST /saved_queries. backend stores raw; migrate to structured later.

anya: ui: show gray micro-pill under name: "from <route> • <model>" tooltip shows pin + timestamp. avoids new columns.

ops-bot: infra: migration queued (PR #4999). feature-flag saved_query.origin added.

devin: telemetry: emit console_event on save with origin + tokens_estimate snapshot. that gives per-route burn visibility.

leo: i'll add a lightweight GET /routes/:id/preview-estimate?model=... that returns tokens_p50 and tokens_p95 for UI preview.

anya: plan: canary 10% next Wed. any blockers?
